messages:
Maria: Hey team — thinking about adding a 'cache savings' breakdown to the cost dashboard. Idea: show tokens saved (and $ saved) by prefix/KV cache vs. batching vs. quantization per route+model. Any thoughts on attribution model? cc @Jon @Kevin
Jon: Nice. Main tricky bit: attribution windows. If cache kicks in for a request because of earlier request, who gets credit? route that primed cache or route that benefited? We need defined lookback (e.g., 24h priming credit) or attribute to beneficiary.
Kevin: I vote attribute savings to beneficiary, but expose a 'priming' metric so teams that warm caches get visibility. Otherwise folks will game warmers.
Sasha: Agree. Also watch out for double-counting when batching + cache both apply. Proposed approach: estimate baseline compute tokens per-request (no cache, no batch), then decompose actual savings in order: cache -> batching -> quantization.
Maria: Can you drop that pseudo-SQL?
Kevin: ```sql
SELECT route, model, SUM(request_tokens) AS rt,
       SUM(kv_hits) AS kv_hits,
       SUM(batch_saved_tokens) AS bs,
       SUM(quant_saved_tokens) AS qs
FROM request_summaries
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route, model;
```
Jon: We'll need a per-model token $ rate table (model_variant -> pp_token_cost) that can change over time. Also backfill rules for historical comparisons.
Sasha: UI suggestion: stacked bars (cache/batch/quant) per route and a small sparkline for unit econ (cost per 1k tokens) + delta vs baseline. Tooltip with 'how we attribute' note.
Maria: Operationally we'll need new telemetry tags: route_id, model_variant, kv_hit boolean, batch_size, quant_profile. Can we spike this without blowing ingestion costs?
Kevin: Keep per-request summaries in runtime (one small JSON per request) instead of per-token events. That keeps ingestion bounded.
Jon: For rollouts, collect per-variant metrics and add automatic regression alerts (e.g., cost per request up >5%). Console should show canary vs control.
Sasha: Edge case: cached responses may have shorter gen lengths; TTL vs staleness semantics should be surfaced in the view.
Maria: Action items: 1) eng-platform add telemetry schema PR; 2) runtime to emit per-request summaries; 3) analytics to add cache-savings view + attribution note. Volunteers?
Kevin: I'll do the runtime PR this week.
Jon: I'll mock the analytics SQL and dashboard tiles.
Sasha: I'll draft UX copy for the attribution tooltip and canary thresholds.
deploy-bot: created issue #4587 (https://issues.redwood/4587) and added to the epics board.
Maria: Thanks — prototype by EOW would be great. :rocket:
